QuestInfo.name: [Halloween] Hallowkitty's Halloween Bash!
QuestInfo.0:
#eHallowkitty's Halloween Bash! Event#n

#bEvent Period#k
 
10/25/2017 - 11/08/2017 00:00:00

#bEvent Details#k

#b#eGather Halloween Candy#k#n
Hunt monsters near your level, the Halloween Elite monster, or the event monster that appears in Henesys and Leafre at every hour to get #bHalloween Candy#k!

#b#eGrow a Cat-O-Lantern#k#n
Help the Cat-O-Lantern grow with #bPumpkin-Flavored Halloween Candy#k! As the #bCat-O-Lantern#k grows bigger, you grow stronger! You can even get the #bDaily Cat-O-Lantern Gift#k that Hallowkitty prepared!

#b#eTrick or Treat! Sharing Candy#k#n
Sit on the #bTrick or Treat Chair#k and share #bTrick or Treat Candy#k with as many people as you can! Hallowkitty has prepared a gift for anyone who shares 25 and 50 times. There's also a special gift for #b10,310 people who share the most candy#k during the event!
